jobs.occupation: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?
jobs.description:
Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark?

Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

• Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).

• New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).

• New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.

• Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.

• A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.

Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

• Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.

• Value a strong professional network across hospitals.

• Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.

• Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.

• Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.

• On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).

About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

• The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.

• Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

jobs.description:
Spend season 2027 with us!

FOOD TRUCK TEAM MEMBERS

Flåm, Eidfjord & Norheimsund, Norway

Good food. New faces. A team to be part of. And the Norwegian fjords just outside.

Looking for a season somewhere different? Come and join our food truck teams in Flåm, Eidfjord or Norheimsund. You'll prepare food, meet guests and share busy days with the people working beside you.

Already worked in hospitality? We'd love to hear about it. Taking your first steps? You're welcome too - everyone receives training. Bring a willingness to learn, a friendly approach and the energy to get involved.

Your part in the team

• Get to know our food and prepare dishes using the recipes and training we provide.

• Give guests a warm welcome and friendly, attentive service.

• Help orders reach the right guests smoothly, even when the pace picks up.

• Keep your workstation, equipment and service area clean, tidy and ready to use.

• Follow food hygiene and safety procedures.

• Share the work, help your colleagues and follow your Manager or Site Coordinator's guidance.

You'll feel at home in this role if...

• You enjoy meeting people and want guests to leave with a smile.

• You're reliable, ready to learn and happy to support your colleagues.

• You can stay organised and work efficiently during a busy service.

• You speak English at B2-C1 level.

• You hold a valid category B driving licence - this is required for the role.

• Hospitality experience is welcome, but it isn't essential. We'll train you.

What's waiting for you

• Full-time seasonal work with hourly pay and several contract periods to choose from.

• Training to help you settle into your role and get to know our food.

• The chance to meet new colleagues and work together in Norway's fjord region.

• Help finding accommodation for your season in Norway.

• A staff meal on each working day.

Join our team and spend the season surrounded by Norway's breathtaking fjords! With food trucks in Flåm and other beautiful locations, we're all about great food, friendly faces, and making people feel welcome. We'd love to have you on board and share an unforgettable season together! Send your CV and recomendation: job@grpnorway.com

jobs.occupation: Tour Guide – Voss & the Fjords of Western Norway - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Trade a life of hustle and bustle for a summer in the Norwegian fjords and mountains. Meet guests from around the world, join our friendly international team and gain valuable experience while exploring spectacular landscapes, small communities and some of Norway’s most beautiful destinations.

Hva vi ser etter
Who We Are Looking For

If you are curious, service focussed, reliable and enjoy working closely amongst a team of individuals who enjoy connecting with people and working in a dynamic environment, then we are very interested in talking to you.

Requirements:

• 

Fluency in English and at least one, of the following languages: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Norwegian, Dutch or Chinese. Portuguese can also be an advantage. Proficiency in two or more of these languages in addition to English is considered a strong advantage.

• 

If you are not a Norwegian citizen, you must be an EU/EEA citizen or already have a valid Norwegian work permit.

• 

Interest in Norwegian history, culture, and nature.

• 

Guide Certification (or willingness to obtain one).

• 

Strong and demonstrable verbal communication skills are a huge advantage

• 

An experienced team player

Not Certified Yet?

As a part of our quality guarantee to our clients, our guides must hold at minimum a Guide Certification ensuring high professional standards. Several certification options are available in Norway.

We work together with and recommend the Guide Academy Certification Programme , which includes an engaging online course (completed remotely) and an intensive on-site training session in Voss starting April the 12th 2027.

No prior guiding experience is required, only passion and enthusiasm!

We sponsor the certification fee for candidates who commit to working a full season exclusively with Voss og Fjordane Guideservice.

Arbeidsoppgaver

What is working as a Guide in the Voss area like?

As a Tour Guide, you'll lead guests through some of Western Norway's most spectacular fjord and mountain landscapes.

Assignments range from scenic coach and fjord tours to ferry excursions, walking tours and hikes. You'll lead groups of up to 50 guests, share local stories and culture, and take responsibility for creating a safe, engaging and memorable experience.

The job is dynamic: schedules can change, and some tours will be repeated throughout the season. But every group is different, and there are also opportunities to work from other ports and experience more of Western Norway.

Vi tilbyr
What We Offer

• 

An international job in the heart of Fjord Norway - Experience a more authentic side of Norway, living and working among fjords, mountains, traditional villages and small local communities. Voss gives you a quieter base close to nature, while your assignments take you through some of Western Norway's most attractive destinations.

• 

A seasonal job with variety - Most assignments take place between May and mid-October, with additional guiding opportunities from April and into the later part of the year.

• 

Guaranteed minimum seasonal income - More predictability while still retaining the variety and flexibility that comes with guiding.

• 

Professional training and certification sponsorship - We'll help you gain professional qualifications and can sponsor your Guide Certification, including visits to destinations and venues throughout the region when you commit to a full season with us .

• 

Fair working conditions - We focus on creating a sustainable, inclusive and positive working environment. We provide full paid training on company specific procedures, tour logistics and guest service standards,

• 

Explore more of Fjord Norway - Your workplace extends far beyond Voss, with opportunities to guide in Flåm, Eidfjord, Ulvik, Vik, Odda, Rosendal and other destinations across the region. Assignments outside our normal region come with higher pay and paid travel time.

• 

Opportunities to grow - Guiding can be a first step into a wider career in tourism, hospitality and destination development.

Support with finding accommodation

Moving to Voss? We help make the move easier by arranging accommodation for most of our seasonal guides. This is subject to availability and at the guide's own expense. We can also provide guidance if you prefer to find your own place.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
About Voss og Fjordane Guide Service

The first official private guide service in Norway, with over 38 years of experience, Voss og fjordane Guideservice has a team of over 40 guides dedicated to creating exciting and meaningful experiences for guests visiting the fjord and mountain region of Western Norway.

Our philosophy is simple: when our guides are enthused, our guests will be as well -- enthusiasm is, after all, contagious! We spend much time developing and nurturing our team, ensuring that each guide can be a trusted leader, an exciting storyteller, a proud ambassador of the fjord region culture and a collaborative and engaging team member.

We deliver over 3,000 assignments every year, collaborating with over 90% of the cruise calls in some of the most beautiful cruise destinations in the country.

Our aim is to be the best we can be, and to get better every day!
